sources.title: Tesla's Alternative Geometry Coil

sources.title: Bifilar coil - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: A bifilar coil is an electromagnetic coil that contains two closely spaced, parallel windings. In electrical engineering, the word bifilar describes wire configurations used in Tesla's designs.
